g.text: enter / power_relay_on = true; set_power(HEATING); auto_off_from = now_ms;
enter / set_phase(BREWING); set_stop_reason(NONE); pump_on = true; brew_started_at = now_ms;
exit / pump_on = false; set_phase(IDLE); auto_off_from = now_ms;
enter / steam_on = true; set_power(ON); steam_started_at = now_ms; steam_cmd_at = now_ms;
2. ENTER_STEAM [cmd_max_ms != 0] / set_reply(OK); steam_cmd_max_ms = cmd_max_ms; steam_cmd_at = now_ms;
3. START_BREW [cmd_max_ms != 0 && power_is(READY)] / set_reply(OK); set_start_source(APP); brew_cmd_max_ms = cmd_max_ms;
